name: setTimer
description: Set a countdown timer. The timer will fire after the specified duration with an audio and visual alert. Use this when the user asks to set a timer for a specific duration (e.g., 'set a timer for 5 minutes').

duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds until the timer fires. Convert from user's request (e.g., '5 minutes' = 300, '1 hour' = 3600).

label.description: Optional label for the timer (e.g., 'pizza', 'laundry', 'break'). If the user mentions what the timer is for, use that.
